svg.title: Architecture
svg.desc: The coding agent keeps its own model. Path A: the agent passes file paths to the local gemini4 MCP server, which reads the files, filters secrets and sends them to Gemini; only the answer returns. Path B (Claude Code, optional): a local gateway pins the root conversation to one model and runs subagents and background calls on Gemini.

svg.text: Claude Code, Codex CLI or Cursor. The main conversation stays on the model you chose, so its prompt cache is not disturbed.

svg.text: A · MCP SERVER (ALL HARNESSES, NO PROXY)

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: • Reads files inside the workspace only; follows .gitignore
• Never reads .env, keys or credentials; redacts tokens
• Generated code goes to .gemini4-staging/ for review
• Returns a short answer with path:line citations
• Reports real token usage from the API

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: • Root conversation pinned to one model per session
• Subagents on gemini-3.8-flash, background on Flash-Lite
• Hybrid: Claude models forwarded to Anthropic unchanged
• Optional per-session and global spend caps
